# Generated by `bazel run //platform/buildScripts:plugin-model-tool` - do not edit.
# Whether a module can be packed as a plain `lib/modules/<module>.jar` is a repo-global AND over every
# `plugin-content.yaml`, and the JPS-to-Bazel converter folds it over the reports it parses anyway. These are
# the community modules a community-only checkout would fold differently, because the reports that decide them
# are in the ultimate half: `+` is a candidate, `-` is not, and the sign is the whole-repo answer either way.
# A `+` line names the module libraries merged into its jar after the module name, because the fold agrees on
# that set as well and a community-only checkout cannot see it.
